LanguageData.DU_CasketLinks: Deathrest buildings: {0} in use, {1} enabled, {2} linked
LanguageData.DU_CasketUnpowered: Casket unpowered: linked buildings are inactive.
LanguageData.DU_CasketNoLinks: No deathrest buildings linked. Build them in the same room as this casket and they link automatically.
LanguageData.DU_BuildingNoLinks: Not linked to any deathrest casket. Build it in the same room as a casket and it links automatically.
LanguageData.DU_FuelLeft: {0} left at current use, serving {1} caskets
LanguageData.DU_ToggleTip: Enable or disable this link. Disabled links never come back on by themselves.
LanguageData.DU_JumpTip: Click to select and jump to it.
LanguageData.DU_Status_Active_Desc: The pawn deathresting in this casket gets this building's effect.
LanguageData.DU_Status_CasketUnpowered_Desc: The casket has no power, so none of its linked buildings work. A casket draws more power for every building it uses.
LanguageData.DU_Status_Idle_Desc: Nobody is deathresting in this casket. The building will be used when someone does.
LanguageData.DU_Status_Dormant_Desc: The building and casket are no longer in the same room, or have no line of sight. The link comes back when they do.
LanguageData.DU_Status_OverCapacity_Desc: The deathrest capacity limit is enabled in the mod settings and this casket's pawn is at capacity. Earlier links take priority.
LanguageData.DU_Status_OverStackLimit_Desc: Stack limits are enabled in the mod settings and this casket already uses the maximum of this building type. Earlier links take priority.
LanguageData.DU_SettingUncapDesc: On: a casket uses every linked building. Off: each casket is limited by its pawn's vanilla deathrest capacity.
LanguageData.DU_SettingStackLimitsDesc: Limits how many buildings of one type a single casket can use (vanilla: 4 glucosoid pumps, 4 psychofluid pumps, 2 accelerators).
LanguageData.DU_SettingCasketPowerDesc: While deathresting, a casket draws its base power x exponent^n, where n is the number of buildings it uses.
LanguageData.DU_SettingExponentPreview: Casket draw by buildings used (100 W casket): {0}
LanguageData.DU_SettingBuildingPower: Building power scales with caskets served
LanguageData.DU_SettingBuildingPowerDesc: A building serving several deathresting pawns at once draws its power once per casket.
LanguageData.DU_SettingFuel: Hemogen use scales with caskets served
LanguageData.DU_SettingFuelDesc: A fueled building serving several deathresting pawns at once burns hemogen once per casket.
LanguageData.DU_SettingHideSerum: Remove the serum from traders and loot (restart required)
LanguageData.DU_SettingHideSerumDesc: The serum stays in the game so saves load, and existing serum can still be used, but traders, quest rewards and loot no longer offer it.
